means.idiom-jp: B のことで A を祝う
means.example-sentence: We gave a gift to Mary to congratulate her on her promotion.
means.sentence-jp: 私たちは昇進のことでメアリーを祝うために贈り物をした。

cloze.maskedText: We gave a gift to Mary to ____ her on her promotion.

notes: for を使うのは主に米。
